research_stop: Stopping with S-Q1-002.physics_mle (resu-00147, exp-0010, val rel_l2 0.019323) as the best executed full-fidelity arm. The program has reached the limit of what the available adapters can produce. Both required studies ran to completion on the val split (fingerprint edfcc32d..., 750 rows, row_hash 260db427...): S-Q1-001 was inconclusive on a matching-protocol technicality, and S-Q1-002 re-registered the same arms with every differing field listed, completing all three required arms, all five diagnostics, and the two optional seed-1 arms. Measured results, not self-certified: rel_l2 is 0.07741 for extra_trees (control_et, resu-00141), 0.019323 for bounded log-k MLE (physics_mle, resu-00147) and 0.019330 for the ET-initialized LM hybrid (hybrid_lm, resu-00145); paired relative improvement is 0.750 with interval [0.729, 0.770] for both treatments at B=200, and the hybrid-vs-physics paired difference is -0.00036 with interval [-0.00126, 0.00021], all far from the 1% margin; seed-1 replicates (resu-00140, resu-00143) move rel_l2 by less than 0.0004 relative for ET and 0.0008 for physics; per-target rel_l2 for physics is [0.0268, 0.0060, 0.0050, 0.0263] against [0.117, 0.028, 0.029, 0.092] for ET, so outer segments carry about 5x the error of inner segments under every method (Q-2, local evidence only). The fit_report spot checks (200 rows) show residual std at truth 9.95e-4 against nominal 1e-3 and model_mismatch=false; 2-sigma coverage is 0.957 with z_rms 0.98. Every claim in S-Q1-002 remains 'inconclusive' solely because blocking objections 016, 017, 018, 020, 021, 022, 024 and 029 require source-level artifacts (forward-operator parity, CFL ratio, bound handling, per-row convergence logs, initializer identity) that only a coding_execution specialist can produce. That path is closed: tasks 001 and 003 both failed at adapter setup with 'study requires a nonempty stable id' regardless of how the id was supplied, action-006 was rejected on the depth/children limit, and the analysis adapter (task-004) returned only a B=200 re-run of one pair. Resolving objection-020 from the executor's own forward_evals logs was rejected twice, the second time because the independent critic has not accepted the resolution, so further resolve_objection attempts would repeat the same outcome. Resources: 661 s of 760 s wall time remain and cumulative measured forward spend is 731,311 of 3,000,000 (about 24%), so stopping is not budget-driven; it is driven by the absence of any action that can create new verifiable evidence. Scope limitations carried into the final export: results hold only in the inverse-crime setting (exact forward model, known IC, known Gaussian noise sigma=0.001); the control is one untuned extra_trees configuration; row-bootstrap intervals exclude ET training-seed and multistart-RNG variation; no seed-1 hybrid exists; the forward-eval split into residual/Jacobian/rejected-step counts is unmeasured; and no synthesis should rank hybrid against physics, attribute the hybrid result to the ET initializer, or generalize beyond this sensor layout and discretization. Verdicts remain with the independent verifier.
